lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: You have a ship. We can smell the fuel on you. That is a compliment.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: ...Thanks? Can I help you two with something?

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Perhaps. Perhaps you can help each other. My sister does not speak. She listens.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Pilgrims. Travellers. Two humble voices of a very old choir. Nobody important. Please forget our faces.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Everyone stares at the robes. We are used to it. The robes are warm, and the hoods hide the chanting.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: She is not staring at you. She is staring at your ship. There is a difference. A small one.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: If you are looking for work, courier, ask. We always have work. For the right kind of ship.

options.line: So who exactly are you two?
Why the robes? It's warm in here.
Why is your friend staring at me like that?
